comments.comment:
This ticket was raised for sanity-pfl/2b, but since this is a network error, it appears on other pfl tests too.

For sanity-pfl/16b: https://testing.whamcloud.com/sub_tests/a3d9260e-4c31-467d-9268-5a4e193274f9 

[ 1628.371890] Lustre: 84385:0:(client.c:2498:ptlrpc_expire_one_request()) @@@ Request sent has failed due to network error: [sent 1789549346/real 1789549346]  req@ff2d304c81207400 x1876477343411840/t0(0) o101->lustre-MDT0001-mdc-ff2d304c4563a800@10.240.24.223@tcp:12/10 lens 24568/135824 e 0 to 1 dl 1789549362 ref 2 fl Rpc:eXPQr/600/ffffffff rc 0/-1 job:'lfs.0' uid:0 gid:0 projid:0

It seems this issue can also show up as a timeout: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/cf31e6c6-d6af-436e-92ea-6ca2d1c4e9ee

[Wed Sep 16 21:08:14 2026] Lustre: lustre-OST0002-osc-ffff9231c8e70800: Connection restored to 10.240.26.58@tcp (at 10.240.26.58@tcp)
   ... same req ffff9231d65730c0 / x1876523869107456 resent every 5 s, client_bulk_callback status -5 ×1054, "Connection restored" ×19, "was lost" ×18 ...
[Wed Sep 16 22:38:00 2026] LustreError: 3613:0:(events.c:193:client_bulk_callback()) event type 1, status -5, req ffff9231d65730c0 desc ffff9231d6613400 mbits 1876523870515072
[Wed Sep 16 22:38:00 2026] Autotest: Timing session out! Timeout has been exceeded but the test framework is still running (lustre-reviews_custom_131862.1001)

It seems this issue has been occurring consistently since January 2026 in interop with b2_15 and b2_16, particularly starting with build 4697.

Build 4695 (Jan 15) for sanity-pfl and sanityn had seen 36 testsets passing in full-part-3, and 34 of 36 testsets timed out in build 4697.

A few examples of the passing sessions (from 4695):

  • server b2_15 client rhel10.0: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/2e84a751-5817-4339-9244-d2593261b771
  • server b2_16 client rhel10.0: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/4401a22b-b07c-4b67-8ac6-cdba9a363eb4
  • server b2_15 client rhel9.7: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/8cafb174-4a3c-40d1-92cf-362b3d04df76 
  • server b2_16 client rhel9.7: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/ee1759a8-6e0a-4858-94c6-cd47ab58f24f 

The same as timing out in 4697:

  • server b2_15 client rhel10.0: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/bda8696e-bd95-4737-ba6a-e7a42fcdacd5
  • server b2_16 client rhel10.0: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/a46944ae-b073-4e37-9f09-2fb9653514c3
  • server b2_15 client rhel9.7: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/bbf5bdc6-e298-4e5d-a873-ab6b015e3294 
  • server b2_16 client rhel9.7: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/87c735a4-a095-4b3d-ab6b-d2ad677d6a5c

I confirmed via the debug patch https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/69014 that the failures and timeouts since January seem to be due to LU-19763 socklnd: Check sendpage_ok for ZC | https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/63266 , which removed some special handling for VM hosts and enabled socklnd zero-copy. The debug patch disabled this once again, and the issues disappeared. Similar issues exist on sanity-sec (LU-20213). It is not yet clear why this issue occurs only during interop. I cannot reproduce this issue locally.

Root cause: patch https://review.whamcloud.com/60202 ("LU-19139 lnet: add accept_port_bulk module parameter") (commit ce7611a495, v2_16_57-74) added accept_port_bulk with a fixed default of 988 that does not follow accept_port. Autotest sets accept_port=7988, so a master client connects its socklnd BULK_IN/BULK_OUT sockets to port 988, which 2.15/2.16 servers never listen on. The client silently runs with only a CONTROL conn to each server. Patch https://review.whamcloud.com/63266 ("LU-19763 socklnd: Check sendpage_ok for ZC") (commit bf67df3212, v2_17_50-65) then enabled zero-copy for >=16KiB sends on VMs; the server must send the ZC-ACK on its BULK_IN conn (the client's BULK_OUT, since nonblk_zcack=1), which doesn't exist, so ksocknal_launch_packet() fails with -EHOSTUNREACH, all conns to the client are closed, and the client is evicted. LU-19763 is only the trigger; reverting it (patch https://review.whamcloud.com/65658 ("LU-20213 dbg: revert patch")), or restoring the VM zc_min_payload default (patch https://review.whamcloud.com/69014 ("LU-20770 dbg: disable socklnd zero-copy for 2.16 interop test")), hides the problem but the client still has no bulk conns.

Evidence, from sanity test_27cg https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/df2265f8-c35f-4596-9a0c-b53345f620b8 (client 2.17.56.51, servers 2.16.1.2), subtest debug logs:

servers:        LNet: Accept all, port 7988
client dk:      (lib-socket.c:436:lnet_sock_connect()) Error -111 connecting 1023 -> 10.240.26.124:988
client dk:      Too soon to retry route 10.240.26.124 (cnted 2, interval 60, ...)   <- only CONTROL conn up
MDS console:    (events.c:313:request_in_callback()) event type 2, status -113, service mdt

(The console "Connection to ... at host 10.240.26.124:7988 was refused" message is misleading: lnet_connect() prints the control port, but the refused connect was to 988.)

Server version correlation (sanity test_27cg, master client, last 27 days):

servers runs failed has LU-19139
b2_15 37 4 no
b2_16 30 4 no
b2_17 16 0 yes

b2_17/master servers open a second listener on 988 whenever accept_port_bulk != accept_port (lnet_acceptor_add_sockets()), so the client's bulk connects succeed there.

Same failure also seen as OST bulk evictions (server_bulk_callback() event type 3, status -113) in sanity-pfl test_0a, and in sanity-pfl test_16b (see also LU-20673, LU-19868, LU-20213). Sites using the default accept_port=988 are not affected, since both ports are then the same.

Fix (patch to follow): default accept_port_bulk to accept_port, and retry a refused bulk connect on accept_port for older peers. Workaround until then: options lnet accept_port_bulk=7988 on master nodes in interop testing.

"Andreas Dilger <adilger@thelustrecollective.com>" uploaded a new patch: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/69145
Subject: LU-20770 lnet: bulk conns use accept_port by default
Project: fs/lustre-release
Branch: master
Current Patch Set: 1
